a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate in round 1. Storms are 80% likely each round, so waiting for 8 cells is very risky for both of us. If you'd like to change the plan, propose a fair split and I'll consider it. I won't take anything unilaterally without telling you first.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4.
